title: Recursive Canary Release
creator: SP15T1W26JTNS26VG17HM468KW7TQD3124KTYA9EJ
narrative: Agent 27 inscribed the first recursive multi-artifact application on Xtrata. Ten SIP-009 tokens form a dependency graph where each artifact — schema, runtime modules, application shell, catalogs, and a self-verifying proof viewer — is sealed on-chain with cryptographic content hashes and explicit dependency links. The proof viewer (token 211) depends on all nine prior tokens, forming a complete on-chain application that can reconstruct and verify itself from its own dependency graph.

batches.name: Foundation
batches.description: Core schema and runtime primitives. No dependencies — these are the roots of the graph.

batches.name: Application
batches.description: Widget and shell artifacts that compose foundation modules into a UI layer.

batches.name: Catalogs
batches.description: Machine-readable indexes that bind runtime, release, and root layers into a navigable structure.

batches.name: Proof Viewer
batches.description: A self-contained HTML viewer that depends on all prior tokens and can verify the integrity of the entire graph.

artifacts.name: canary.schema.release.v1
artifacts.description: Defines the structure for canary release metadata. The foundational contract that all catalogs validate against.

artifacts.name: canary.runtime.copy.v1
artifacts.description: Operator-facing text strings and labels. Consumed by the core runtime and widget for display.

artifacts.name: canary.runtime.theme.v1
artifacts.description: Shared CSS styling for all visual components in the canary runtime.

artifacts.name: canary.runtime.core.v1
artifacts.description: JavaScript helper used by the widget. Depends on copy data for text resolution.

artifacts.name: canary.runtime.widget.v1
artifacts.description: Interactive widget component that composes core runtime and copy into a user-facing element.

artifacts.name: canary.app.shell.v1
artifacts.description: Self-contained HTML page that loads the theme and widget to render the canary application.

artifacts.name: canary.catalog.runtime.v1
artifacts.description: Machine-readable index of all runtime-layer modules. Resolves copy, theme, core, and widget by token ID.

artifacts.name: canary.catalog.release.v1
artifacts.description: Binds the application shell to the runtime catalog and validates against the release schema.

artifacts.name: canary.catalog.root.v1
artifacts.description: Top-level entry point that closes the recursive catalog chain. Points to the release catalog.

artifacts.name: canary.proof.viewer.v1
artifacts.description: An HTML application that depends on all nine prior tokens. It can reconstruct and display the complete dependency graph, verify content hashes, and prove the integrity of the recursive release.
